title: Cylinder ageing-furnace temperature records: a direct thermocouple-to-recorder arrangement
summary: Two instruments may both display temperature while obtaining their signals differently. Suneng's 2020 technical agreement text for a Type III aluminium-alloy gas-cylinder ageing furnace requires thermocouples to connect directly to the paperless recorder, without feedback transmission through the temperature controller. Check the signal source before reviewing channels, measurement points and acceptance conditions.
